technique.models: Textureless MeshBasic materials with key, sky fill, highlight and bubble rim evaluated per vertex; one merged vertex-colour draw for solids.
technique.effects: 192 preallocated slots, one shared dynamic RGBA mesh, 4096 triangle ceiling, 24 Hz wake emission within 140 m, precomputed ring/glint shapes.
technique.cache: Twelve bounded immutable geometry assets shared across instances; per-instance glass opacity.

icons.source: Locally baked from the actual Gouraud meshes using race-powerups-review.html

browser.gallery: All twelve rendered without shader errors; 13 draws / 14332 triangles.
browser.liteCountryClub: Native race exceeds 1753 m with no falls. Boost/star/shield/projectile combination observed at 42 m/s, 544 effect triangles / one draw. HUD loads the 192px baked icon.
browser.fullCountryClub: Production build 10-19 09:16 UTC: boost, star, shield, shells, water bomb and horn activated during native racing. 44 m/s, over 1244 m, zero falls; combined initial burst 1264 effect triangles / one draw. Matching shield icon visible in HUD. No console errors.

delivery: Local only; no publish, push, uploads or remote deployment.

timing.note: Includes a 13.8-minute blocked browser download call and the development-module loader fallback to the built runtime.

reviewTools.productionRace: After build, node tools/build-race-powerup-review.mjs; visit /race-powerups-game-review.html?playtest&level=country-club. Synthetic controls and external-controller isolation are local review only. The next build removes generated fixture files.
reviewTools.iconBake: The gallery Bake HUD pictures action downloads twelve 192px transparent WebPs in one JSON; existing HUD keeps using static pictures, adding no live HUD rendering.
